C45029.observed: What was checked: whether changing something on an existing part and then closing the row throws the change away without asking. What happened: the quantity was changed from 2 to 7 and the row was closed with Escape. A confirmation appeared first, reading "Discard these changes?" with the warning "The changes you made will be lost." and the choices "Keep Editing" and a discard action. Choosing to discard closed the row and the part went straight back to what it said before - quantity 2, description unchanged. Nothing was saved.
